dedupe_keys.name: national agricultural machinery purchase and application subsidy records for china 2021 2022 science data bank

description: Records of subsidies paid for the purchase and use of agricultural machinery in China in 2021 and 2022, collected by web crawling of the public subsidy disclosure systems. The Science Data Bank record says the systems cover 31 provinces and 38 provincial-level units, including the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps and the state farm systems of Guangdong and Heilongjiang, and that 2,283,928 items were collected from 22 provinces and municipalities, among them Beijing, Tianjin and Shanxi. It is meant to analyse regional differences in machinery purchase and subsidy payment, and to support policy evaluation. Version 1 was issued on 13 November 2023 as three downloadable files totalling about 272 MB (format not stated on the page read), free under CC BY 4.0, with metadata in Chinese and English. Coverage is 22 of the 31 provinces over two years. Caveats: crawled data depend on what each province publishes, nine provinces are missing, and field definitions are not given in the metadata read. For simulation it shows where and what kind of farm machinery is being added each year, to update the fleet and mechanisation capacity of agent-based and supply chain models and to evaluate subsidy policy. A related catalogue record is the agricultural machinery stocks in 337 cities, 1978-2020.
